## TL;DR

- [1Password Environments][1]
- [NVIDIA OpenShell][4] and its [1Password integration][2]
- [Skills for Real Engineers][5] by Matt Pocock

## 1Password Environments

[1Password Environments][1] store a project's environment variables in 1Password instead of in `.env` files.

- tbd

## NVIDIA OpenShell

[NVIDIA OpenShell][4] is an open-source runtime that runs AI agents like Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in sandboxes. Policies control which files and network hosts the agent can reach.

The [1Password integration][2] ([announcement][3]) hands secrets from an Environment to an OpenShell sandbox. The agent inside only ever sees placeholders, and OpenShell's gateway swaps in the real values for requests to hosts you approved.

- tbd

## Skills for Real Engineers

[Skills for Real Engineers][5] is [Matt Pocock's][6] collection of small, composable agent skills for coding agents, covering things like grilling you about a plan, test-driven development, code review and domain modeling. I set them up for this blog's repository.
